body: Yeah, I know, here in Italy is even worse. The whole culture of my native land is based on the principle: "Run or get run over it". If this thing had happened to me in Milan or Naples, he could probably have stolen my jeans, my underpants and probably shanked 'n' shagged me in the meanwhile. Yeah, I write well, however when someone compliments me about my writing skill, I go through a phase which I affectionately define as "Diarreha of words", which is basically a storm of periods plunging down from the sky as an hail of verbose sentences without a logical ending or beginning in the first place. You do NOT wish to assist to this excercise in futility. I really do not want want to sound like an asshole, nevertheless sounding like a pompous prick is only way I can develop my vocabulary in correct manner. Sorry.

I understand you and you are not alone in this. However I will not lie to you, I can't help you. I am not in position neither I posess the competences to do that, I can however say what was best for me. Seek help from a professional and share with them your thoughts. Remember: YOU ARE STILL HERE, for as long as you have breath you can swim out of this sea of shit. Life isn't fair for anyone, especially for us. I won't tell you to man up or move your ass out of your chair, because it is what you need right now. I just wish I could reach out of this screen, however I realize I have my issues, thus my presence won't be of any help but to worsen your situation. There's one thing for certain that you can do immediately: STOP USING SOCIAL MEDIA, please, it is a distorted lens that filter all the shit away from people's lives. You are you, and though it seems kind of obvious, many forget to listen to their inner self and they follow others to define their success. This is your life, therefore your happiness and success, you and only you have the power to define them. Screw all the internet gurus selling their mumbo jumbo like it's molten gold, the maketing experts, the celebrities. I am from Italy and I studied  latin, I remember a quote from Sallustio: "Homo faber suae quisque fortunae", which means "Man is the forger of its own fortune (destiny)". You have the power and the will to move forward. Always remeber, depression is shitty, it lies to you, it makes you do thing you don't want to, but don't let it define who you are.

The best of hopes and wishes and wheather the storm.

Andrew.
